title: B-004/B-005 implementation remains NOT_STARTED; blocked by four HIGH Security Architecture findings

rationale: The Final Pre-Product Security Architecture audit returned PASS WITH FINDINGS. The four HIGH findings block the B-004/B-005 runtime implementation because they involve fail-closed native crypto handle lifecycle, B-021 matrix machine enforcement, registration single-class fail-closed gaps, and DB schema authority contradiction. The preserved Coverage Gate text is not rewritten; this is a later, narrower Human exception. title: Human pre-authorization of the canonical, non-self-mintable task anchor for ANOX-TASK-S2-CORRECTION-001 (review finding C-01 / R09)
decision: Authorize exactly one bounded, metadata-only governance delivery (ANOX-TASK-S2-C01-PREAUTHORIZATION-001 on branch governance/s2-c01-preauthorization-001, from then-current canonical main 02179ecd34fde81a0cc8866a09653cab8ff40f38) whose sole purpose is to establish a non-self-mintable pre-delivery authorization anchor required to close C-01/R09. The governance delivery may: (1) record this Human decision in the canonical decision registry; (2) create the minimum canonical task record for ANOX-TASK-S2-CORRECTION-001 in docs/workforce/registries/tasks.jsonl binding branch remediation/s2-correction-001, start_sha 02179ecd34fde81a0cc8866a09653cab8ff40f38, and its already-reviewed allowed/forbidden path scope; (3) update only the minimum continuity/workforce metadata necessary to make that preauthorization canonical and internally consistent. The authorization must exist on canonical main before the S2 correction delivery may consume it; the anchor must not depend on any record created by the S2 correction delivery itself.
rationale: Independent correction review INDEPENDENT-S2-CORRECTION-REVIEW-001 verified 13/14 findings fixed but returned S2_CORRECTION_REVIEW_FAIL on C-01/R09: validate_s1_build_provenance.py derives its protected-Rust authorization from tasks.jsonl records that a delivery can mint itself (tasks.jsonl is inside the delivery's own allowed_paths). The required trust anchor is authorization evidence present on canonical main before the delivery — which only a human-gated path can establish, because every in-branch registry write is inside the delivery's own minting power. This decision supplies that external anchor so the separately-authorized validator correction can bind to it.
does_not_authorize: reusable blanket permission for future deliveries
automatic PR, merge, release or signing action
